criteria.GREEN: Healthy green fruit; natural stem is not automatically a defect.
criteria.RIPE: Healthy ripe fruit; natural stem is not automatically a defect.
criteria.REJECT: Visible mold, rot, bruise, black spots, skin scar or crack regardless of ripeness.

serving_policy_unchanged: highest_confidence; label semantics do not restore REJECT precedence or a 70% decision threshold.

review_scope.description: Contact-sheet visual screening of every train REJECT, every RIPE and every held-out REJECT, plus training disagreements; selected ambiguous stems inspected at original resolution. This is provisional review, not independent expert labeling.

limitations: Most GREEN-only images retain original labels without exhaustive visual relabeling.
Repeated physical fruits and capture scenes may occur across existing splits; inherited hash groups do not establish independence.
REJECT criteria greatly reduce clean RIPE examples; report class support and do not claim production accuracy.
Known mold and natural-stem challenge images are development diagnostics, not an independent test.
